subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Which _________ do you usually take to reach your office?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**route**" is used to describe the way or path taken to reach a destination.
 
• Options like** "rude," "rout," and "root"** are **incorrect** in this context.
 
• "Rude" refers to impoliteness, **"rout" **refers to a disorderly retreat or defeat, and "root" refers to the part of a plant that is usually hidden underground.
 
• Thus, the correct choice is "**route**" as it appropriately fits the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Which **route** do you usually take to reach your office?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Route:** A way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination.
 
• **Rude:** Offensively impolite or ill-mannered.
 
• **Rout:** A disorderly retreat of defeated troops.
 
• **Root:** The part of a plant that attaches it to the ground or to a support, typically underground, conveying water and nourishment to the rest of the plant.
